content.value: A turbo-jet engine flying at a speed of 800 km/hi consumes air at the rate of 42 kg/sec. Given the enthalpy change for the nozzle is 200 kJ/kg, velocity coefficient is 0.95, air-fuel ration is 70, heating value of the fuel is 43 MJ/kg and combustion efficiency is 95%; calculate - (i) thrust specific fuel consumption, (ii) thermal efficiency of the plant, (iii) propulsive power, and (iv) overall efficiency.
